en.headline: Hannah Pong opens first solo show at PMQ
en.dek: A free body-art exhibition by Hong Kong artist Hannah Pong runs at PMQ unit H303 from 9 to 17 October.
body: Hong Kong body-art artist Hannah Pong opens her first solo exhibition at PMQ in Central on Friday, running until 17 October.
PMQ lists the show, titled Human Transformation, in unit H303 on Hollywood, open daily from noon to 7pm. Entry is free. It is presented by Livin Artspace.

The venue description says the exhibition translates temporary body painting into hand-painted works, including life-sized photographic prints, airbrushed leather mirrors, postcards and modular ceramic figures that can be taken apart and reassembled.

According to the Chinese listing on the same page, Pong trained in special-effects make-up under Gary Chan from 2016 and graduated in 2022 from the Department of Arts and Design at National Tsing Hua University in Taiwan, where she began a series of ceramic figures that can be taken apart.

zh.headline: 龐學文首個個展今起在元創方展出
zh.dek: 人體藝術家龐學文的免費個展於元創方H303舉行，展期由10月9日至17日。
body: 香港人體藝術家龐學文（Hannah Pong）的首個個人展覽周五起在中環元創方舉行，展至10月17日。
元創方資料顯示，展覽名為「人體蛻變」，場地在荷李活樓H303，每日中午12時至下午7時開放，入場免費，由 Livin Artspace 主辦。
場地介紹指，展覽把短暫的人體彩繪轉成手繪作品，包括還原人體比例的攝影印刷、噴槍曼陀羅皮革鏡、明信片，以及可以拆開再組合的陶瓷人偶。
同一頁的中文介紹寫，龐學文2016年起跟隨特效化妝師陳嘉偉習藝，2022年畢業於台灣國立清華大學藝術與設計學系，並在當地開始可解構的陶瓷人偶系列。
